name: automated_unblocking_of_bounced_okta_emails_via_sy
title: Remove Bounced Emails with Custom API Action
description: This template provides an on-demand flow to remove one or more email addresses from Okta's bounce list using the Remove Bounced Emails API (bulkRemoveEmailAddressBounces) called via **Okta - Custom API Action** card in Okta Workflows.
